findings.text: the module docstring states that every panel draws both the reference and the terminal state's nulls, but terminal nulls are drawn only when a terminal state exists and all six rows of this run are refused, so the committed panels carry the reference set alone and the description overstates them.

on every refused row terminal_profile_combination carries the profiles-implied target (identical to target_combination on all six row files) although no terminal state exists, so the receipt asserts a terminal reading on a row that was refused and a reader must cross-read status to learn that the number is a target.

justifications.durability: tests/test_equilibrium_constraint_protocol.py:753 converges the row to the imposed amplitude while :527 and :805 pin its two refusals, so a regression of the row or of its refusal contract fails the file.
justifications.evidence: docs/figures/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov/shafranov/receipt.json records status refused on all six rows with the reason naming p_prime and gaps from -0.1213 to -0.1662 (magnetics lower), the two failing protocol ids reproduce as 2 failed / 9 passed in 80.53 s in a fresh all_debug process captured in head_gate.log and are the same ids the pristine-base log shows (base_gate.log: 2 failed, 6 passed in 23.19 s), the six panels exist with the wall on each, and the nine commits touch only the declared write paths.
justifications.fit: the class follows the sibling constraint idiom in nova/equilibrium/constraint.py (dataclass fields and required_unknown at :1379-1381) and introduces no plan label in its added names or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:1354 states and implements the inverted large-aspect-ratio vertical-field identity exactly as the class docstring declares, and the six bank rows carry the refusal the done-when asks for.
justifications.scope_discipline: git log af5a32bf..HEAD shows the nine commits 42d0514e through 49e7ce29 touch only nova/equilibrium/constraint.py, tests/test_equilibrium_constraint_protocol.py, benchmarks/shafranov_pair_receipt.py, docs/figures/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov/shafranov, docs/evidence/archive/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov-landed.html and docs/plans/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov.html, and nothing else.
